item.description:
CoreBlow 2.1.4

Fixes

  • Packaging Resolution: Decoupled core session normalization, Matrix storage helpers, generated bundled channel/plugin loaders, and plugin-sdk facades from npm-excluded extension directories so standalone npm installs execute doctor, security audit, and mcp cleanly.
  • Regression Gate: Added an automated excluded-extension import boundary check in scripts/check-release-sync.mjs.
